vulnerabilities.weakness: Stateful emptyDir volume without persistence – cart data lost on pod restart, breaking checkout
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the redis-cart pod is killed, cart contents are lost and checkout fails

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica with no PDB/HPA – pod failure stops cart and checkout
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the cartservice pod is killed, cart operations and checkout fail

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica entrypoint with no PDB or HPA – a pod failure brings the entire site down
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the frontend pod is killed, the site becomes unreachable for all users

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica with no PDB/HPA – failure stops entire checkout flow
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the checkoutservice pod is killed, all checkout steps fail

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica with no PDB/HPA – failure slows or breaks product display during checkout
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the productcatalogservice pod is killed, product data is unavailable, slowing checkout

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica with no PDB/HPA – failure degrades recommendation feature
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the recommendationservice pod is killed, recommendations fail but checkout continues

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica with no PDB/HPA – failure only affects email notifications, expected to fail gracefully
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the emailservice pod is killed, order emails are not sent but checkout succeeds

vulnerabilities.weakness: Single replica with no PDB/HPA – failure only affects ad display, expected to fail gracefully
vulnerabilities.hypothesis: if the adservice pod is killed, ads stop but site remains functional

systemic: All services lack PDBs and HPA, making any single pod failure a high‑impact risk; all have single replicas, increasing availability risk
blind_spots: Facts do not reveal internal timeout or retry logic, so actual failure propagation may differ from the hypothesized impact
